cellfmcount-dapi-count.split: released DAPI trainval/test; fixed seed0 10% trainval validation (ceil)

preprocessing.transform: existing deterministic eval resize + center crop + ImageNet normalization

cellfmcount-dapi-count.feature_definition: concatenate selected CLS tokens and final selected patch mean; L2; BF16 extraction; float16 storage
cellfmcount-dapi-count.aggregation: pooled held-out images; no per-specimen macro claim; fixed train only, no validation refit
limitations: Validation holdout and frozen Ridge are our extension, not reproduction of fine-tuned density-map models.
Original filenames/specimen IDs are absent; official image-ID split does not establish biological independence.
Source coordinate cardinalities must match source counts; finite out-of-bounds annotations are retained as scalar-count diagnostics.

idcia-condition-count.grouping: celltype + treatment condition across imaging dates, antibodies, FOVs and channels
idcia-condition-count.exclusion: four subfield images with jointly allocated counts documented in dataset readme

preprocessing.transform: existing deterministic eval resize + center crop + ImageNet normalization

idcia-condition-count.feature_definition: concatenate selected CLS tokens and final selected patch mean; L2; BF16 extraction; float16 storage
idcia-condition-count.aggregation: pooled held-out images; no per-condition macro claim; no cross-model hyperparameter retuning
limitations: Condition A-D is treatment, not replicate ID.
Four groups only; this is OOD condition transfer, not official supplied image split reproduction.
No donor/specimen identifiers; cannot assert donor-heldout generalization.
This derived scalar task does not reproduce a density-map counting model.
